create_LLM_instance: create an LLM instance using the vLLM LLM class with a specified model name
create_SamplingParams: create SamplingParams with temperature and top_p values for text generation
run_LLM_generate: run the LLM generate method to produce text outputs from a list of prompts
run_main_inference: run the main function to perform offline text inference on sample prompts
summarize_LLM_output: summarize the LLM generate output by extracting prompt and generated text fields
